1.e4 d5 2.exd5 e5 3.dxe6.strategy: Takes the offered pawn en passant, which puts White two pawns up until Black recaptures on e6. The gambit gives Black no more than development in return, so White has no reason to refuse and can calmly finish developing.

1.e4 d5 2.exd5 e5 3.dxe6 Bxe6.strategy: Recaptures with the bishop, which at once becomes active on the open diagonal, so Black is only one pawn down and develops freely. It is the natural way out of the gambit, but White keeps a healthy extra pawn and Black has to compensate with activity.
1.e4 d5 2.exd5 e5 3.dxe6 Bxe6.name: Scandinavian Defence: Boehnke Gambit
